tool.name: nasvar pipeline
tool.description: tumor-only long-read variant calling (SNV / CNV / fusions / ITD / karyotype)

configfiles.configfile: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail shopt -s nullglob mkdir -p out out/focal_plots # Galaxy stores the BAM index in its metadata directory, not next to the .dat. # nasvar requires the .bai alongside the BAM (the v1.1.0 tag does not build # the index inline -- that feature was added post-tag). ln -sf '$bam' input.bam ln -sf '$bam.metadata.bam_index' input.bam.bai # No --log-file: nasvar logs to stderr by default (env_logger). The log level is # set independently of the target, so dropping --log-file changes only the sink, # not the content. Galaxy captures stderr in the job record; with # detect_errors="exit_code" a non-empty stderr is not treated as an error. nasvar pipeline \ input.bam \ '$repeats' \ '$enriched' \ '$sites' \ '$targets' \ '${fasta_source.fields.path}' \ '$gff' \ out/sample \ --config '$config' \ --reference '$reference' \ --gc-correction loess \ --force \ #if $blast_ratio: --blast-ratio $blast_ratio \ #end if --min-depth $advanced.min_depth \ --plot-y-percentile $advanced.plot_y_percentile # Stamp the input identity. nasvar derives the report's "Run ID" from # basename(out_prefix) only, and records nothing about the input in result.json. # We keep the fixed out/sample prefix and write the input BAM dataset name into # both artifacts. Sanitisation deferred: assumes a clean dataset name (no quotes, # no '&' or '|' that would disturb the sed replacement below). run_label='$bam.element_identifier' # (a) Report: rewrite the single Run ID line. "sample" occurs exactly once in the # HTML, as this value, so the anchored substitution is unambiguous. sed -i "s|Run ID: sample|Run ID: \$run_label|" out/sample.report.html # (b) result.json: prepend an 'input_label' field. jq --arg is JSON-injection-safe # regardless of the label content. Atomic via temp file in the work dir (not /tmp). jq --arg input "\$run_label" '{input_label: \$input} + .' out/sample.result.json > out/sample.result.json.tmp \ && mv out/sample.result.json.tmp out/sample.result.json # Guarantee existence of conditional declared outputs (empty = not produced). # Lets from_work_dir succeed and the wrapper run cleanly on samples with # insufficient coverage where karyotype/coverage stages are skipped. Only files # that are still declared outputs are listed here (the karyotype SVGs were dropped # in galaxy1 and the gc_vs_coverage SVGs in galaxy4, so neither is guaranteed). for f in \ out/sample.breakpoints.fa \ out/sample.coverage.gc_adjusted.tsv; do [[ -f "\$f" ]] || touch "\$f" done # Isolate per-gene focal-depth SVGs (data-driven by pipeline_config) for # Galaxy collection discovery. Move anything that is not a named pipeline SVG. # IMPORTANT: the karyotype.* and gc_vs_coverage.* SVGs are no longer exposed as # outputs, but nasvar still writes them, so they MUST remain in this keep-list -- # otherwise they would be swept into the focal_plots collection. They stay in # out/ and are discarded with the work directory. for f in out/sample.*.svg; do case "\$(basename "\$f")" in sample.karyotype.gc_corrected.svg|\ sample.karyotype_baf.gc_corrected.svg|\ sample.gc_vs_coverage.svg|\ sample.gc_vs_coverage.gc_corrected.svg|\ sample.karyotype.svg) ;; *) mv "\$f" out/focal_plots/ ;; esac done

param.name: bam
param.label: Aligned BAM (tumor)
param.help: Sorted and indexed BAM. The dataset name is written to the report Run ID and to result.json (input_label).

param.name: fasta_source
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA, indexed)
param.help: Admin-installed reference genome from the all_fasta data table.

validator.message: No indexed reference genome is registered in this Galaxy. Ask the admin to install one via the data manager.

param.name: gff
param.label: Gene annotations (GFF3)
param.help: Must match the chosen reference genome coordinates.

param.name: repeats
param.label: Repetitive regions (BED)
param.help: Used for coverage masking and BAF site filtering.

param.name: sites
param.label: MAF sites (TSV)
param.help: Tab-separated SNP positions for BAF: CHR POS REF ALT.

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome configuration (JSON)
param.help: Centromere and PAR coordinates for the chosen reference genome (e.g. T2T-CHM13v2.0).

param.name: enriched
param.label: Enriched regions (BED)
param.help: Regions targeted by adaptive sampling on the sequencer.

param.name: targets
param.label: Gene targets (BED)
param.help: Enriched genes of interest for fusion calling (no padding).

param.name: config
param.label: Pipeline configuration (JSON)
param.help: Panel-specific: gene list, thresholds, SNV transcripts, one-sided genes, focal-depth plots.

param.name: blast_ratio
param.label: Tumor fraction (blast ratio)
param.help: Optional. Estimated tumor fraction in [0.0, 1.0] for copy number adjustment. Leave empty for no adjustment.

param.name: min_depth
param.label: Minimum read depth at MAF site
param.help: Sites below this depth are treated as spacers in the BAF plot. nasvar default: 20.

param.name: plot_y_percentile
param.label: Karyotype plot y-axis percentile
param.help: Per-segment percentile for the karyotype plot y-axis limit. nasvar default: 0.95.

data.name: breakpoints_fa
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: fusion breakpoint consensus (empty if no fusions)

tool.help:
**nasvar pipeline** — full tumor-only long-read variant calling pipeline.
Detects SNVs, CNVs, gene fusions, internal tandem duplications, and infers karyotypes from aligned BAM/CRAM files produced by Oxford Nanopore PromethION sequencing, typically with adaptive sampling on a targeted gene panel.
This wrapper was developed for clinical-research use on B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) in collaboration with the Institut de la Leucémie (Paris).
----
**Inputs grouped by coherence**
- **Per-sample**: aligned tumor BAM. - **Reference-genome bundle**: FASTA (admin-installed, via all_fasta), GFF3, repeats BED, MAF sites TSV, reference JSON. All five must describe the *same* reference genome — mismatch will silently produce wrong calls. - **Panel bundle**: enriched BED, targets BED, pipeline JSON. All three must describe the *same* analysis panel.
**Outputs**
Clinical report:
- ``report.html`` — clinical report (formatted, renders inline in Galaxy). Its "Run ID" shows the input BAM dataset name. The karyotype+BAF figure is embedded inline in this report; the standalone karyotype SVGs are not exported (extract from the HTML if a separate SVG is needed). - ``result.json`` — unified machine-readable output with all calls, QC, and metadata. The wrapper prepends an ``input_label`` field (the input BAM dataset name), which nasvar itself does not record.
Quantitative tables:
- ``coverage.tsv``, ``coverage.gc_adjusted.tsv`` — binned read depth (raw + GC-corrected) - ``maf`` — minor allele frequencies at SNP sites
Conditional / variable:
- ``breakpoints.fa`` — fusion breakpoint consensus sequences (empty if no fusions detected) - **Focal depth plots (collection)** — one SVG per gene declared in the ``plots`` section of the pipeline configuration JSON. Number and naming depend on the panel.
The nasvar execution log is written to the job's **stderr** (visible in the job details), not to a dedicated dataset.
----
**Provenance**
This Galaxy wrapper resolves ``nasvar 1.1.0`` from the local conda channel, which is built from the upstream GitHub tag ``v1.1.0`` (commit ``eb285440957124d1d3c65aee0ba0aa291726313a``, source tarball sha256 ``6bdf329766a2d1fe6ae40006d02dd7f827e8f6c057df72e443348e1906ab7a37``).
The clinical version cited in patient reports should be ``nasvar 1.1.0`` (tag), not any locally-compiled binary post-tag.
